concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of three *real* validated datasets. Task T004 adds a synthetic‑data fallback ("if any URL check fails, generate synthetic data") which weakens the functional requirement by allowing the pipeline to succeed without real data.

The dependency map lists FR‑011 (synthetic DGP) which does not exist in the specification. Introducing a new functional requirement not authorized by the spec constitutes an orphan requirement and violates constraint preservation.

FR‑005 (VIF) and SC‑003 require that all VIF scores be < 5. While T008 implements VIF calculation, there is no verification step or test asserting that every VIF score meets the < 5 threshold, leaving the success criterion untested.

SC‑004 demands a stability flag indicating whether > 50 % of sensitivity‑sweep p‑values cross the 0.05 threshold. Task T012 creates the sweep files but does not produce or verify such a flag, so the acceptance criterion is missing.

FR‑008 mandates halting the analysis and producing `halt_log.json` when core constructs are missing. T004 mentions writing `halt_log.json` but no verification test checks that the pipeline actually aborts on missing constructs, risking silent continuation and a breach of the requirement.
